asset_links_one_target.name: asset_links_one_target
asset_links_one_target.value:
("asset_links"."topic_id" IS NOT NULL) + ("asset_links"."question_id" IS NOT NULL)
    + ("asset_links"."attempt_id" IS NOT NULL) + ("asset_links"."source_id" IS NOT NULL) + ("asset_links"."revision_id" IS NOT NULL) = 1

assets_dimensions.name: assets_dimensions
assets_dimensions.value:
("assets"."width" IS NULL OR "assets"."width" > 0)
    AND ("assets"."height" IS NULL OR "assets"."height" > 0)

revisions_one_target.name: revisions_one_target
revisions_one_target.value:
("content_revisions"."course_id" IS NOT NULL) + ("content_revisions"."chapter_id" IS NOT NULL)
    + ("content_revisions"."topic_id" IS NOT NULL) + ("content_revisions"."question_id" IS NOT NULL) + ("content_revisions"."attempt_id" IS NOT NULL)
    + ("content_revisions"."learning_state_id" IS NOT NULL) = 1

import_items_commit.name: import_items_commit
import_items_commit.value: ("import_items"."question_id" IS NOT NULL AND "import_items"."committed_version" IS NOT NULL) = ("import_items"."status" = 'committed')

learning_states_next_review.name: learning_states_next_review
learning_states_next_review.value: "learning_states"."next_review_on" IS NULL OR (length("learning_states"."next_review_on") = 10 AND date("learning_states"."next_review_on", '+0 days') IS "learning_states"."next_review_on")

provenance_one_target.name: provenance_one_target
provenance_one_target.value:
("provenance_links"."topic_id" IS NOT NULL) + ("provenance_links"."question_id" IS NOT NULL)
    + ("provenance_links"."attempt_id" IS NOT NULL) = 1

questions_difficulty.name: questions_difficulty
questions_difficulty.value:
"questions"."difficulty" IS NULL OR
    (typeof("questions"."difficulty") = 'integer' AND "questions"."difficulty" BETWEEN 1 AND 5)

questions_source_date.name: questions_source_date
questions_source_date.value: "questions"."source_date" IS NULL OR (length("questions"."source_date") = 10 AND date("questions"."source_date", '+0 days') IS "questions"."source_date")

review_item_resolution.name: review_item_resolution
review_item_resolution.value:
("review_items"."resolved_at" IS NULL) = ("review_items"."outcome" IS NULL)
    AND ("review_items"."outcome" NOT IN ('independent', 'assisted', 'practice') OR "review_items"."answer_mode" IS NOT NULL)

sources_date.name: sources_date
sources_date.value: "sources"."occurred_on" IS NULL OR (length("sources"."occurred_on") = 10 AND date("sources"."occurred_on", '+0 days') IS "sources"."occurred_on")
